**Regulatory Basis:**

- **Exit obstruction mitigation**: South exit is viable alternative (within 18m travel distance)

**Occupancy Violation Response:**
- ✅ **Room 3-6 attractiveness** → Set to **0.0** (avoid all new entry)

**Board Updated:**
- Escalation flag: **YES** — Room 3-6 requires immediate compliance action; facilities must clear north obstruction

All actions cite **ADB Vol2 Table 2.1** (travel distance limits) and **Clause 2.43** (bedroom occupancy standard) for care homes.
